_comment: Where the external tools live. Copy to tools.json and edit. Relative paths are from the repo root; bare names are looked up on PATH. Override the whole file with VP_TOOLS=/path/to/tools.json.
_twitch_downloader_note: Only needed for the download stage. Get it from https://github.com/lay295/TwitchDownloader/releases -- do not commit the binary. If you already have your footage on disk, use --clip and this is unused.
